questions.question: Write the IUPAC name of: CH₃CH(OH)CH₂CH₃
questions.solution:
Longest chain: 4 carbons = butane
OH on C-2 → **Butan-2-ol**
questions.knowledgeNote: IUPAC priority: carboxylic acid > ester > aldehyde > ketone > alcohol > amine > alkene/alkyne.
questions.answer: CH₃CH(OH)CH₂CH₃ — the OH is the principal group, so numbering starts from the nearest end to it: C-1 = CH₃, C-2 = CH(OH), C-3 = CH₂, C-4 = CH₃ ⟹ parent **butane**, OH at **C-2**. **IUPAC name: butan-2-ol** (sec-butyl alcohol). **Deep point:** both ends are CH₃, so the tie is broken by the functional group's locant — numbering from the right would put OH at C-3, which is why the OH end wins.
